structured_output.world_model: W4 round 2. The tip (0.7548 @ 6.64s) is probably a mildly lucky draw. Its margin over the 0.753 bar is 0.18 pp. Run-to-run noise for a recipe change is about 0.2 pp on the 3-seed mean accuracy and about 1.5% on time. Most single-knob tweaks (label smoothing, lr, wd) should come out null within that noise. Diagnostics and the Newton-Schulz step cut change the recipe little. Held-out seeds will probably show a 10-seed mean about 0.1-0.2 pp below 0.7548. Time is mostly compute-bound, so there are few cheap systems wins.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic. The 10-seed mean regresses slightly below 0.7548 (mean-regression offset about 0.1 pp). The per-seed std is about 0.25 pp, which fits H4.1.2. Time is unchanged.
LS 0.2 versus 0.3 is likely within noise. With a short schedule and EMA, 0.3 may be slightly better, so the effect is under 0.3 pp.
Muon lr x1.5 is a coin flip. The previous lr is probably near the optimum, and the noise is about 0.2 pp.
Halving wd is likely null, since Muon fixes the weight norm anyway. It may help or hurt the other groups by a small amount.
The code already uses 3 Newton-Schulz steps, not 5. The idea may be a no-op or may go to 2 steps. The time saving is at most about 1%, and accuracy is flat.
The step is likely mostly GPU-bound. Removing small host syncs gives about 0-3%. Changes to the augmentation path reshuffle the RNG, so the accuracy noise is the same as for any other change.
Plain EMA without resetting the fast weights probably recovers less than Lookahead does, and the tip has little margin. It is more likely to fall below the bar than to improve on it.

cruxes: What are the true 40-seed mean accuracy and per-seed std of the tip (I016)? This decides whether any margin remains to trade for time.
Is the train step launch-bound or GPU-bound, i.e. what is the GPU idle fraction? This decides whether the systems ideas, including CUDA graphs, can give a gain above 3%.
Does the Muon lr, label smoothing or wd have a real optimum away from the current setting, or is it all within the 0.2 pp noise?
